theme: Dark Glassmorphism with Signature Gold & Electric Purple Accents
context: Integrated standalone emoji speed-bingo game inside Treesh Music App

layout_and_architecture.structure: Single standalone file (nects.html) or React JS modular single-page application maintaining high performance vanilla/React states

top_bar.left: Nects Logo & Treesh back navigation link
top_bar.right: Treesh Profile Pill with user avatar, nickname, @username, Starlites counter with animated star icon
top_bar.click_action: Opens sliding Treesh Profile Panel from top-right with scale + blur transition

screens.description: Mode picker grid showing 12 game modes with badges, grid size & difficulty selector, Quick Play button, daily bonus highlight
Caller emoji display with audio/visual flash, Player board (interactive grid), Opponent Mini Board with real-time speed progress, Scoreboard, Powerup Tray, Timer bar
Slide-out Treesh profile panel with avatar, Starlites history, match statistics, unlocked badges, and achievement progress
Tabbed store for Powerup refills, Color Themes, Emoji Packs (Cyber, Retro, Elemental, Animals, Food), and Game Mode unlocks using Starlites
Victory/Defeat breakdown, Starlites earned, win streak bonuses, replay and mode return buttons

game_modes_supported.name: Blitz Mode
game_modes_supported.description: 3-second countdown per turn! Fast reaction required

game_modes_supported.name: Daily Challenge
game_modes_supported.description: Seeded daily board for global high scores

game_modes_supported.name: Survival
game_modes_supported.description: Endless rounds against scaling bot difficulties

game_modes_supported.name: Gravity Grid
game_modes_supported.description: Claimed emojis drop to bottom row altering lines

game_modes_supported.name: Fog of War
game_modes_supported.description: Board emojis revealed briefly or on tap

game_modes_supported.name: Chaos Mode
game_modes_supported.description: Random board swaps and wildcard events during round

game_modes_supported.name: Pass & Play
game_modes_supported.description: 2 players on a single shared screen

game_modes_supported.name: Puzzle Solver
game_modes_supported.description: Claim complete lines in N or fewer taps

game_modes_supported.name: Zen Mode
game_modes_supported.description: No timer, no opponent — practice & relaxing matches

game_modes_supported.name: Custom Lobby
game_modes_supported.description: Choose custom grid sizes (3x3 to 6x6) & bot difficulty

testing_attributes.mandatory_data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on all buttons, cards, inputs, tabs, modals and stats

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark glass visual language strictly matches Treesh design tokens (#0a0a0b background, purple #9328ff accent, gold #c3ab69 highlights).
Persist Starlites earnings directly to localStorage under 'treesh_stars' and append activity log entries under 'treesh_activity_log'.
Implement smooth scale & blur transitions for all modals and the top-right profile panel.
Add data-testid to every interactive component for automated test validation.
Keep mobile responsiveness primary with clean touch targets (minimum 48px height).
